name: Test integrity guard
summary: Block newly introduced test suppressions and explicit shell removal of test sources.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for Bash, Write, and Edit that compares bounded test-source changes for newly introduced skip, expected-failure, or ignore markers and rejects statically recognizable shell deletion or rename-away of test files without duplicating focused-test checks.
refuses: It does not run tests, measure coverage, repair a test, or decide whether a suppression is justified.
It does not inspect or block focused-test markers because that boundary belongs to debug-artifact-guard.
It does not infer a test deletion from arbitrary scripts, dynamic paths, interpreters, build tools, or unsupported shell constructs.
It does not expose a project-writable allowlist, inline bypass, environment override, or agent-controlled approval mechanism.

entrypoints.purpose: Compare bounded test changes and reject new suppressions or explicit static test-source removal.
